تعاركت (form VI)
# تَعَارَكْتُ (taʕāraktu) /ta.ʕaː.rak.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَعَارَكَ (taʕāraka)
# تَعَارَكْتَ (taʕārakta) /ta.ʕaː.rak.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَعَارَكَ (taʕāraka)
# تَعَارَكْتِ (taʕārakti) /ta.ʕaː.rak.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَعَارَكَ (taʕāraka)
# تَعَارَكَتْ (taʕārakat) /ta.ʕaː.ra.kat/: third-person fem
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
